messages:
emily: FYI — Nora Health procurement says they will not accept the invoice unless a customer PO is printed on the invoice and the vendor name matches their vendor registry. They put payment on hold until we provide a PO-backed invoice. :grimacing:
raj: Do we already have a PO from them on file? I don't see one in Salesforce or our billing notes.
olivia: I spoke with their AM yesterday — procurement emailed a PDF that looks like an internal PO template but it has no PO number, just a requisition id. They said 'no number, no pay'. They want vendor address + tax id on invoice too.
emily: Here are the details Nora gave: vendor name should be "Redwood Inference, Inc.", remit-to email billing@redwood.com, and they need our EIN on the invoice. They also attached a vendor setup form. Linking the doc: https://drive.redwood/attachments/nora-vendor-form.pdf
raj: OK — two things we need: 1) generate a new invoice that includes a PO number field (we can put their requisition id in a note if they don't have a formal PO yet), and 2) confirm vendor name and EIN on our billing record. I'll open a Finance ticket.
emily: Their procurement insisted specifically: "we require a PO number before we will accept an invoice for payment processing." They said accounts payable will only process invoices that contain "PO: <number>" in the header.
olivia: Can we adjust the invoice template quickly so we can mark it as "For PO: TBD" and resend? If they refuse that, they said procurement needs a formal PO from their side.
raj: Quick repro / check list for ops: 1) Verify customer billing profile has vendor name EXACTLY as they listed; 2) Add EIN to our vendor record; 3) Render invoice with a visible PO field; 4) Mark invoice status = "On Hold - Awaiting PO" in our system so it won't auto-send to collections; 5) Attach vendor setup pdf to the invoice record.
emily: I tried to create a manual invoice draft: invoice #INV-2026-319 is draft. I added a comment: "PO pending from Nora Procurement." But invoice generator doesn't expose a PO field in the header by default.
raj: For step 3 we can cheat: add a short line at the top of the invoice "PO: <enter PO here>" in the invoice notes field, and toggle the include-in-email flag off until it's finalized. Finance will need sign-off to mark as ready.
voices-bot: invoice-system: invoice INV-2026-319 created (status: draft) and assigned to raj.
olivia: Can you also confirm whether tax/VAT handling matters? Nora is US-based so they want EIN not VAT, but they asked for a W-9.
emily: They asked for a W-9 yes — I attached it to the thread and uploaded to the vendor record.
raj: I'll add the W-9 and vendor form to the vendor profile now. After that's done, I'll update the invoice draft with the "PO: <requisition id>" field and set status to "Pending PO". Then we'll ask the AM to forward the official PO if/when they issue one.
olivia: I'll ping the AM and procurement contact to request that they issue a PO number or confirm the requisition id can be used as PO. I'll include the exact invoice draft fields so they can confirm.
emily: Thanks. Please note customer said they will not process payment until their system has the PO number on a PDF they can ingest. If we need to delay the invoice until they formally issue a PO, that's fine but want to avoid accidentally sending the 'invoice' that will be rejected by their AP.
raj: Agreed. Action items: Raj -> update vendor record + attach W-9 and form; Raj -> modify INV-2026-319 header with "PO: <requisition id>"; Olivia -> confirm with AM/procurement whether requisition id is acceptable as PO; Emily -> hold any auto-send rules on customer until confirmed.
emily: tagging for visibility @olivia @raj :thumbsup:
olivia: will update here when procurement responds.
emily: Closing loop: if procurement provides a formal PO number we'll regenerate a final invoice (include required fields: PO, vendor name exactly as they provided, EIN). If they refuse a PO number we will escalate to sales leadership for exception policy.
raj: I'll log the hold in the invoice system and set a follow-up reminder for 7 days. If no PO in 7 days, escalate.
